thread:
adele: Quick FYI  onboarding Orpheus-8B hybrid (fp16 baseline, int4 production, int8 validation). We see a small but actionable long-context QA regression where named entities get clipped and occasional duplicated small words after ~450 tokens. suspect: tokenizer normalization + rotary freq scaling differences between kernels.

ryan: Can you paste the repro command and top metrics?

adele: repro: ./onboard/eval --model orpheus-8b --dtype int4 --prompts longnews_3k.txt --max-tokens 1500 --batch 5 --seed 101
metrics (fp16 -> int4): EM 81.0 -> 76.4, Rouge-L 45.1 -> 41.0, p95 latency 240ms -> 78ms. Pattern: after emoji/ZWJ or combined-accent boundaries we see token count shifts and downstream 1-2 token drops or a duplicated article like "an an".

mina: Which tokenizer conversion path? We saw similar with converter v6 that enabled aggressive canonicalization (NFKC by default) and an updated emoji folding.

adele: Used hf-converter v6 default (NFKC + emoji fold). Tokenmap diff around examples shows merged emoji and merged combining diacritics, sequence length delta = -1 in several docs.

ryan: That can shift positions for rotary lookup. Also check runtime rotary metadata and quant kernel autotune freq_scale/interp.

adele: runtime dump: rotary_base=10000 head_dim=64 per_head_scale=true
fp16_kernel: freq_scale=1.0 interp=none
int4_kernel: freq_scale=0.990 interp=kbit-linterp

mina: Two quick isolates: 1) re-run int4 forcing freq_scale=1.0 + interp=none; 2) re-convert tokenizer with NFKC disabled and emoji preserve flag.

adele: Did both. Results: forcing freq_scale=1.0 gives EM 78.0 (partial); tokenmap preserve (NFKC off + preserve-zwj) gives EM 79.2; both together EM 80.5 (nearly closing to fp16 81.0). Duplication/clip cases mostly resolved in sampled set.

ryan: Action items:
- adele: open PR documenting converter v6 caveat and include 100 failing examples into /shared/onboard/orpheus/tokenmap-audit. Add a token-count diff script for CI.
- mina: add runtime canary flags to pin rotary_freq_scale and interp for quant kernels and surface mid-doc tokencount deltas during canary.
- infra: add a small unit that tokenizes 200 canonical long docs with both converter settings and fails on any length delta >0.

build-bot: ci:tokenizer-audit -> queued job orpheus-tokencount-check (200 docs).

adele: I'll also run a 1k blind A/B with mixed long/short contexts once PR + canary flags are live. If residual edgecases remain, we should run a short per-head sin/cos requant calibration on a long-doc corpus (5k-10k steps).

ops-bot: deploy:quant-kernels/2026-04-10 11:00 UTC -> Canary queued (3 GPUs) pending PR merge and CI green.

ryan: Good triage. Also add check in onboarding checklist: "verify token counts across converter versions; avoid NFKC by default for onboarding unless explicitly validated."

mina: Will draft the PRs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
